items.title: Venezuela’s Response to Earthquakes Exposes Government’s Shortcomings
items.summary: The government turned to the world to respond to twin quakes. But years of shrinking budgets and political repression weakened its ability to rescue countless people trapped in rubble.

items.title: Fires Wrecked Their Village in France. Now They Want Answers.
items.summary: After fleeing France’s worst wildfire in decades, residents of Le Porge, a village west of Bordeaux, returned home 13 days later. They found a town in ruins.

items.title: Ukraine Is Pleading for Air Defenses. Will the World Listen Anymore?
items.summary: Western allies are more hesitant to give up interceptor missiles they may need for their own defense as war rages on multiple fronts.

items.title: Country Music Festival Lights Up Nairobi
items.summary: Fans gathered in Kenya to celebrate a genre born far away but that more and more Africans are coming to appreciate.

items.title: Budget Airline Jetstar to Charge Fees for Using the Overhead Bin

items.title: Europe’s Control of Its Fate Is Tested by Iran and Ukraine Wars, Wildfires and Migration

items.title: The War That’s Happening Above Russia and Ukraine
items.summary: The combatants are producing ever larger numbers of innovative aerial weapons, hoping for a breakthrough as ground combat is largely frozen.

items.title: Migrant Crisis Reveals Vast Differences Between Ceuta and Its Moroccan Neighbor
items.summary: Ceuta, Spain, and Fnideq, Morocco, are physically separated by only a mile, but they are intertwined by family and trade. A recent border crisis is the latest chapter in their story.

items.title: Israeli Strikes May Undermine Trump’s Peace Plan for Gaza
items.summary: President Trump announced a proposal aimed at achieving the disarmament of Hamas and an Israeli withdrawal. Israel ramped up attacks on the Palestinian enclave.

items.title: Houthis Threaten to Expand Red Sea Attacks, and Claim Strikes on Saudi Tankers

items.title: Why So Many C.E.O.s Are Getting a Chief of Staff

items.title: A SpaceX Rocket Will Soon Crash Into the Moon
